Verified header & footer use (200 OK, naturalWidth=784); all 6 demo tabs (dashboard/campaign/drip/accounts/warmup/analytics) render with testids and swap demo-panel-{id} containing real from /landing/{file}.png. All 7 static PNGs reachable (200 OK) with naturalWidth=1440. Browser-chrome frame (3 colored dots + 'app.routemail.co/...' URL bar) present and URL bar updates per tab. demo-caption updates per tab (6 unique strings). No old mock labels ('Sara'/'Acme Corp'/'Q1 Outreach 2026') present. Tesseract OCR run on the 6 screenshots: only emails detected are 'maya@routemail.co' (safe-list); 'drip.tester@example.com' / 'Drip Tester' do NOT appear. Regression testids (hero-section, hero-headline, hero-start-trial-btn, pricing-grid, pricing-card-starter, pricing-card-growth, custom-plan-card, faq-accordion, landing-footer, footer-support-email) all present. Custom-plan dropdown updates custom-plan-price ($199 -> $349 for 30k slab). Mobile @ 390x844: scrollWidth=clientWidth=390 (no horizontal overflow), demo image scales to 356px (fits within viewport), demo tabs wrap cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: LandingPage.jsx is now ~1122 lines (previously ~1300). Still above the recommended 700-line threshold; consider extracting Header, Footer, InteractiveDemo, FeatureSections, PricingSection, FAQ into their own files for maintainability.

Demo screenshots are large (warmup.png = 365 kB, dashboard.png = 183 kB). Consider serving WebP/AVIF or adding loading='lazy' for non-active tabs to improve initial LCP — currently all 7 are eager, but only the active one renders. Right now only `current.image` is rendered, so the impact is small, but a sequence of clicks will fetch each PNG fresh; an <link rel='preload'> for the dashboard image only would be cleaner.

URL-bar text inside the chrome frame uses a small hard-coded mapping (`active === 'dashboard' ? '/dashboard' : `/${active}``) — wrap this into the DEMO_TABS array (e.g. `t.path`) so the data is collocated with the rest of the tab metadata.
test_credentials: Not used this iteration; drip.tester@example.com / DripTest123! is preserved per main agent.
